text: Coffee with Anjali. Her brother Stefan is moving to Glasgow end of the month for a hospital job. Their mum is not thrilled about it. Anjali's helping him pack the weekend before.
Henrik and his wife Aoife viewed a two-bed in Leith on Saturday. They put an offer in the next day. Should text Henrik sometime next week to see if it was accepted.
Long catch up with Asha. She still works at the council planning office, lives in Headingley with her partner Liam. Two kids, Ayo who's 9 and Nia who's 6. Nia is obsessed with dinosaurs.

Meera said her dad's knee operation is early March. She's taking the week off afterwards to look after him. Her sister Ioana flies in from Bucharest the day before. Remind me to check in with Meera after the op.
Hoang finally got the keys to the new flat in Walthamstow! Moving in sometime next week, says the stairs are a nightmare. I'm helping with the van on the Sunday.
Luis lives in Lisbon now, works remotely for a fintech in London. His girlfriend Salma is a vet. They have a greyhound called Pepper.
Abebe's mum passed away last month. Funeral was in Addis, he flew back a week after. He seemed quiet but ok. Need to ring him over the weekend, just to see how he's doing.
Quick one: Aisha mentioned her son Callum starts uni in Manchester in September. She's nervous about the drive up and leaving him there. He's doing physics.
Suzanne's flat viewing on Thursday fell through, landlord let it to someone else that morning. She's looking at two more in Clapham over the weekend. Lives with her sister till then.
Tariq and Ayesha are moving to Bristol over the summer. Ayesha got a job at the university there. Tariq's going to keep working from home. Their little girl starts reception the September after.
Chat with Aleksander after squash. He's a structural engineer at Arup, lives in Bermondsey. Grew up in Kraków, his parents are still there. Supports Legia, won't shut up about it.
Neha says her brother Oscar got engaged to his girlfriend Vanessa. Party is end of the month at their place in Brighton. Don't forget to get a card for Oscar and Vanessa.
Femi's moving back to Lagos early next year, his dad hasn't been well. Leaving do is sometime in December. He seemed a bit torn about it all. I should ask him for a pint before then.
Jorge called. His wife Georgia is pregnant, due early April! They're already looking for a bigger place, probably out towards St Albans. He sounded properly chuffed.
Jin lives in Cardiff with her partner James. Works as a pharmacist at the big Boots in town. Her mum lives with them half the year.
Karim's flat in Didsbury flooded last week. Insurance people come round sometime next week. He's staying at his brother Damian's in the meantime. Must send him the number for that plumber.
Pick up boxes and tape from the post office before Saturday. Meter reading on the day we leave.
Ran into Anjali Shah at the station. She's now head of science at Parkside, still in Harrow. Her husband James is a GP. Their son Tariq is doing his GCSEs this year.
Henrik said Aoife's mum is coming over from Cork for her 70th, mid November. Big dinner the night of, and a day trip to Bath the day after. Aoife wants to get her a nice cashmere scarf.
Stefan's driving test is on the 4th. He's failed twice already and is really stressed. Text him good luck the night before. Ask how it went that afternoon.
Asha and Liam bought a house in Otley! Completion was meant to be end of the month but it's slipped to early November. Their cat Biscuit hates the car so they're dreading moving day.

Talked to Meera about her new job in Edinburgh. She moves up end of January, starts the Monday after. Hasn't found a flat yet, viewing a few online. Her boyfriend Hoang is staying in London for now. Said she's worried about the long distance thing. I'd like to visit in the spring once she's settled, maybe early March.
Ioana's sister had her baby on Tuesday, a little boy called Luca. Ioana's going over to Romania a week after to help out.
Luis mentioned his kids. Both at the bilingual school near Alfama. Oldest, Jorge, plays violin. Youngest is Salma, four, wants to be an astronaut.
Dinner at Abebe's. His wife Nia runs a bakery in Peckham. They live above it. His brother Ayo just moved in with them too.

Aisha Khan's moving out of London, finally. Viewing a cottage near Hebden Bridge sometime next week, if she likes it she'll go back the day after with her husband. Her mum lives up that way which helps. Remind me to ask Aisha how the viewing went.
Saw Suzanne yesterday. Her daughter Georgia got into the Royal Ballet School! Starts in September. Suzanne's both proud and a bit terrified about the fees.
Callum's housewarming was meant to be Saturday but he's cancelled, flat's not ready. Says maybe end of the month instead.

Tariq said his mum's 60th is early December. The whole family's going to Lahore for a fortnight around it. He's flying out the week before. I should get something small for his mum and send it with him.
Aleksander's partner Jin is doing her PhD at Imperial. Second year, something about batteries. They rent in Shepherd's Bush.
Neha's mum had a fall last weekend, broke her wrist. Neha's going up to Leicester every weekend till it heals. She sounded exhausted. Need to call her Thursday.
Oscar and his husband Damian are moving to Copenhagen over the summer, Damian got a transfer. Oscar's learning Danish, badly by his account. They're selling the flat in Hackney first.
Femi Osei, the neighbour two doors down, says his son Karim is home from uni for reading week. Karim's studying law at Durham. Femi wants him to go into the family business.
Note to self: I'm viewing the flat on Fenwick Road Saturday morning, then meeting the letting agent afterwards. Bring payslips and ID. Deposit due by end of the month if I go for it.

Vanessa told me her brother Henrik lost his job last week, the whole team was let go. He's applying for things but feeling pretty low. Their dad keeps sending him listings which isn't helping. Should message Henrik over the weekend.
Jin's dog Mochi has to have surgery on his leg sometime next week. She's taking the day off and the day after. Very anxious about it.
Coffee with Karim. His wife Ayesha works for the NHS in Leeds. He's a teacher. They live in Chapel Allerton with their twins, Femi and Abebe, both 3.
James has been offered a flat in the new block by the canal. Viewing again the day before he signs, just to check the damp. He moves early next month. I'm lending him my drill.
Georgia says her mum Suzanne is moving into sheltered housing near them in Exeter over the summer. Georgia's relieved but her brother Liam is against it. Family meeting about it sometime next week.
Damian's gig at the Jazz Café is the 14th, his band's first proper headline. He's really nervous. Don't forget to text him good luck that afternoon and grab tickets for me and Ayo.
Liam Williams called about the reunion. It's off, not enough people signed up. He's thinking of a smaller dinner sometime in the new year instead.
Nia's husband Hoang is from Hanoi. His parents still live there, his sister Ioana is in Melbourne. Nia and Hoang live in Walthamstow with their son Luis.

Vanessa's moving to Berlin end of the month for her new job at a design agency. Leaving drinks are the Friday before at the Lexington. Her flatmate Aoife is taking over the lease. Remember to bring a card to the drinks and get everyone to sign it.
Ayo's dad is retiring at the end of the year after 35 years at the post office. Big do the weekend after. Ayo hinted his dad would love a new set of golf clubs.
Abebe called about Salma. She's been signed off work with stress, three weeks. He's doing the school runs for now. Check in with Salma sometime next week, maybe drop round with food.

Chat with Meera at the school gate. Her daughter Asha starts secondary in September, they've applied to Parkside and Greenfield. Results come out on 1 March. Meera's mum looks after Asha after school most days. Meera's husband Stefan works nights at the hospital, so it's mostly her doing everything. She seemed tired but in good spirits.
Stefan Schmidt, Stef to everyone, is moving to Munich with his girlfriend Neha early spring. They viewed a place in Schwabing last week. Neha's starting at BMW a week after they land.
Hoang's grandmother is 90 next Sunday. Party at his uncle's in Birmingham that afternoon, lunch at the restaurant the day before. He asked if I could drive his mum up.
Talked to Callum about his sister Aisha. She just moved to Bristol, lives near the harbour. Works as a nurse at the BRI. Callum says she loves it.
Henrik and Aoife's wedding anniversary is the 12th. They're going to Lake Como for a long weekend. Henrik wants ideas for a gift, she's into ceramics.
Bin day moved to Wednesday. Need to sort the council tax direct debit before end of the month.
Jorge Lopez, our new tenant downstairs. From Valencia, works at the airport. Has a daughter, Ioana, who visits at weekends.
Salma's brother Tariq got the flat in Hove! Signs on Monday, moves in the week after. He's been looking since early summer so huge relief. I should send congrats.

Luis's mum is having a hip replacement on the 3rd. He's going home to Porto that week, back the Sunday after. His partner Neha is staying with the kids. Remind me to message him the day after the op to see how she is.
Aleksander says his brother lives in Oslo now, moved for a job with Equinor. Their parents visit him over the summer.
Femi's sister Vanessa has a job interview at the BBC on Friday. Femi says she's been prepping for weeks and is a bag of nerves. He's taking her out for dinner afterwards whatever happens.

Anjali and Aoife are flat hunting together in Manchester, both moving up for the new office. Viewings Saturday in Ancoats and Sunday in Chorlton. They want to be in by early March. Aoife's boyfriend Karim might move up later in the year. Anjali's parents live in Stockport so she'd be near them. I should send them that Rightmove link for the place near the canal.
Asha's son Jin did his first triathlon on Sunday, came 12th in his age group. She was so proud. Asha's husband ran it with him.

Ioana is moving out of her parents' place sometime next week. First time living alone, a studio in Leyton. She's a bit anxious about money. Her dad is helping with the move, I said I'd bring her some plants afterwards.
Georgia and James met at uni. She's a solicitor in Canary Wharf, he's a primary teacher. They live in Greenwich with their spaniel, Bramble.
